code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(out); w=len(out[0]); bg=grid[0][0]
    rails=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        centers=[c for c in range(1,w-1) if row[c]!=row[0] and row[c-1]==row[c] and row[c+1]==row[c]]
        if centers: rails.append((r,centers[0]))
    rail_rows={r for r,c in rails}
    markers=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) if r not in rail_rows for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    # Walk from one endpoint marker through every rail, in row order, to the other.
    ordered=sorted(rails)
    top=min(markers); bottom=max(markers)
    if top[0]>ordered[0][0]: top,bottom=bottom,top
    cr,cc,color=top
    for rr,center in ordered:
        if cr<rr:
            for r in range(cr,rr): out[r][cc]=color
            for c in range(min(cc,center),max(cc,center)+1): out[rr-1][c]=color
        else:
            for r in range(rr+2,cr+1): out[r][cc]=color
            for c in range(min(cc,center),max(cc,center)+1): out[rr+1][c]=color
        out[rr][center]=color
        cr,cc=rr,center
    br,bc,_=bottom
    for r in range(cr+2,br+1): out[r][cc]=color
    for c in range(min(cc,bc),max(cc,bc)+1): out[br-1][c]=color
